context: This criteria evaluates the ability to upload files using multipart/form-data encoding, including adding file attachments and form fields.

checklist.name: File attachment
checklist.description: Correctly attaches files to the request using the attach method with proper field names

checklist.name: Form fields
checklist.description: Properly adds metadata as form fields using the field method alongside file attachments

checklist.name: Multiple files
checklist.description: Demonstrates ability to handle multiple file uploads in a single request
